answer: In an agent marketplace, every identity must lock $100 in a vault for 30 days to receive one auction bid per day. The deposit stays locked even if the identity disappears, so creating 1,000 aliases immobilizes $100,000 rather than multiplying free access. This capital requirement is the basalt foundation of the defense: even an ember of bidding activity from each fake agent requires a full deposit and a month of lost liquidity.
